items.title: 4.2.2 Queue: Best for FIFO Problems (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of when to use a queue (PDF 117).

blocks.text: Queue tab istemal karein jab cheezein aane ki tarteeb mein process karni hon, First-In, First-Out: graphs ya trees ke BFS mein, task scheduling jaise print jobs ya web server ki darkhwaston mein, aur simulations jaise dukaan mein gahakon ki qataar.

blocks.prompt: Web server ko bohat se users ki darkhwastein milti hain. Kaunsa structure unhein munsifana rakhta hai, aur kyun?
blocks.explanation: Queue, kyunke darkhwastein aane ki tarteeb mein poori hoti hain.

items: Queue: aane ki tarteeb (FIFO) ka kaam: BFS, scheduling, qataaron ki simulations.
